title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: both arms taught by BBRv3's logged windows, then RL with the encoder fixed or slow
description: In exp-lcf-cost-315 the free arm (seven free latents from an encoder of neto1 v1's architecture, trained by the critic's loss) diverged in about half its 60,000-update runs at CQL weight 0.1 or more, while the paper arm, whose encoder is neto1 v1 held fixed, never did: a comparison against a learner that does not converge says nothing about the latents' meaning. As a one-off (user, 2026-11-18), the free arm may be trained by any recipe that converges, the learning method being an accepted confounder; to keep the comparison about meaning, the paper arm gets the same recipe as a control, beside its faithful CQL runs. The recipe, with the same networks as before: first a teacher, the actor (and for the free arm the encoder) cloned for 10,000 updates from BBRv3's own logged steps in exp-data-net2-steps-222 (the window multiplier BBRv3 applied each 10 ms; no LCF is used); then, from those weights, RL on all the data with fresh critics for 20,000 updates: expliCCit's CQL at weight 0.01, 0.1 or 1, or TD3+BC at alpha 2.5, all with the window multiplier and Sage's reward. Arms: paper (neto1 v1's seven values; its encoder never moves), freefix (the free encoder learned only from the teacher, then held fixed) and freeslow (then learning at 1e-5 with the critic). rl none keeps the teacher alone. Training seeds 0 and 1: 28 policies, lcft-ARM-RL-sSEED (freeslow with rl none would repeat freefix and is skipped). Training only: a later run scores them in closed loop on net2's own training links beside the faithful arms' chosen configurations.
run: if [ "$ARM" = freeslow ] && [ "$RL" = none ]; then echo "the teacher alone is lcft-freefix-none-s$SEED" > "$OUT/skipped-$ARM-$RL-s$SEED.txt"; exit 0; fi; N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/lcft-$ARM-$RL-s$SEED"; T="$O/teacher"; [ "$RL" = none ] && T="$O"; mkdir -p "$T"; FREE='{}'; [ "$ARM" != paper ] && FREE='{"inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free"}'; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson free "$FREE" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, controllers: ["bbr3"], net2: ({algo: "bc", action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, steps: 10000} + $free)}' > "$T/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$T/train.json" "$T"; rm -f "$T/net1.pt"; if [ "$RL" != none ]; then case "$RL" in cql*) R="{\"algo\": \"expliccit-v1\", \"cql_alpha\": ${RL#cql}}";; td3bc) R='{"algo": "td3bc", "alpha": 2.5}';; esac; E='{}'; [ "$ARM" = freefix ] && E='{"encoder_lr": 0}'; [ "$ARM" = freeslow ] && E='{"encoder_lr": 1e-5}'; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg t "$T/net2.pt" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson free "$FREE" --argjson rl "$R" --argjson enc "$E" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2_from: $t, net2: ({action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, steps: 20000} + $rl + $free + $enc)}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"; fi
collect: { echo "| policy | stage | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft-*/report.json "$OUT"/lcft-*/teacher/report.json; do [ -f "$r" ] || continue; d=$(dirname "$r"); n=$(basename "$d"); s=rl; [ "$n" = teacher ] && { n=$(basename "$(dirname "$d")"); s=teacher; }; case "$n" in *-none-*) s=teacher;; esac; echo "| $n | $s | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
